title: Public Speaking Aversion
eligible_reason: Lab experiment (z-Tree willingness-to-accept for giving a presentation), a Qualtrics classroom experiment (essay vs presentation, ttest by treatment) and a student survey. Regressions are cross-sectional OLS (reg std_ScoreDelivery PresentGood Female [pweight], reg MinP i.PresentStress, survey rank regressions). No panel, no treatment timing, no DiD.
design_notes: Tables 1-4 and Figures 1-4 from labexperiment.dta, classroomexperiment.dta and studentsurvey.dta (readme.txt).
data_provenance_note: Experimental and survey data shipped as collected.
screener_notes: Screened from package; OpenAlex abstract empty. Not a near-miss.
